title: Get what you pay for.
text: Get what you pay for.. The shelf came with a shelf damaged, missing screws, the wrong screws, and the instructions are actually mirrored/opposite of the actual assembly. Power outlet wasn't functional. Thought I had dropped a few screws but assembled the cart with a magnet bowl for all the screws and bolt to be set in. Only opened each plastic packets as I worked on it according to the instructions. Some assembly steps were missing from the assembly packet entirely.

【With Charging Station】 This End Side Table is made of high-quality stainless steel and particleboard,which is durable to prevent scratch and wear.Carrying 2 standard plugs and 2 USB ports with Cable Management 6.5ft long power supply cord in the end side table.

【2-Tiers Storage Shelves】 Design with 2 tiers storage shelves, which is a large space for you to store your favorite books,wines, snacks and more. If there's no place to hide your personal belongings,the hidden storage compartment beneath the top can do you a favor.

【Compact &Chic design 】 The simple design makes the end Table handy for storage in any living room. This bedside table is not only sturdy and wear-resistant, but also emits no undesirable smell or substances, ensuring the safety for your family's health.
